messages:
Liam (Partnerships): kickoff for marketplace go-live collateral. target date Mon 2026-04-06 09:00 PST (embargo). main asks: partner hero assets, partner quotes for blog, PR microcopy, and SI quickstart. who wants which?
Priya (Marketing): I can do PR microcopy + social snippets. sending draft link in a sec.
Tomas (HW Partner): uploading hero images now. note: one horizontal + one square. can you confirm required formats?
Liam (Partnerships): ideal: 1600x600 (hero) and 600x600 (thumbnail). SVG for logos if possible. tag versions.
Maya (Content): I'll draft blog + partner quote slots. need partner headshots and 1-2 sentence quotes.
Tomas (HW Partner): will have quotes + headshots by Thu EOD. internal comms OK.
Jordan (Product): landing needs 1) partner badge area, 2) SI quickstart link, 3) tracking events: marketplace_impression, partner_cta_click. DevEx to implement.
deploy-bot: scheduled staging preview build 2026-04-02T02:00Z -> https://staging.redwood.example/marketplace/preview-20260402
Priya (Marketing): PR draft: https://docs.redwood.example/drafts/marketplace-pr-v2. Comments welcome. I've left a note for legal about claims. :memo:
Elena (Legal): quick checklist: logo usage signed, partner display names must match MSAs, no unverified performance claims. need final assets Fri 18:00 PT for legal clearance.
Liam (Partnerships): fallback if partner art missing: use Redwood generic hero + partner badge. Priya add fallback copy to PR doc.
Priya (Marketing): added fallback and social-friendly caption. also prepared two CTA variants for A/B testing: "Get started" vs "Try it free".
Jordan (Product): noted CTA variants. DevEx will add experiment flags. ETA for tracking and experiment wiring: Fri 14:00 PT.
Maya (Content): drafting 3-step SI quickstart (code snippet + download). will attach to staging preview.
deploy-bot: staging smoke test: rendering ok, missing partner badge alt text on mobile. ticket ENG-10012 created.
Elena (Legal): one more: footer partner logos must link to partner legal notices. Priya pls add link targets.
Liam (Partnerships): final timeline: Fri 18:15 Priya flags PR ready -> Elena legal signoff by 19:00 PT -> Sun deploy dry-run -> Mon prod push (embargo lift 09:00 PST). keep this thread for day-of.
Tomas (HW Partner): no blockers here, will monitor for art swaps.
Priya (Marketing): will flag when doc is ready. thanks all. :rocket:
Elena (Legal): standing by for final artifacts.
Liam (Partnerships): thanks team, ping here for any day-of last-minute changes.
